name: "Shrimp Dumpling" Rice Bowl with Pickled Veggies, Lettuce & Peanuts

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar and sugar in a large bowl; whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup rice vinegar
3 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Trim, peel, and coarsely grate carrots; trim and cut cucumbers into matchsticks. Add both to the bowl with the pickling liquid, toss to combine, and set aside.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the bowl with the green onion, along with soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, oil, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the dumpling sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop shrimp and place in another large bowl. Spoon ⅓ of the dumpling sauce over the shrimp, stir to combine, and set aside. (Reserve remaining sauce for serving.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add shrimp and sauce. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, roughly chop peanuts.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
When the rice is done, add oil, vinegar, and sesame seeds; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Divide rice, shrimp, pickled veggies, and lettuce between bowls. Top with peanuts and serve with reserved dumpling sauce on the side. Enjoy!
